intent: Carry the matched Pages upload and deploy action updates from PR #235 and #236 onto current dev, preserve the .nojekyll publishing artifact with a guarded v5 upload, and enforce the operator's main-only deployment ruling for manual dispatch.

reasons.evidence: The workflow controls future GitHub Pages artifact upload and deployment; current main has no Docs workflow and this task does not dispatch it.
Changing GitHub Actions and pushing dev affects hosted validation.

programme: All four hosted workflows for T-0173 dev@0527d699 completed successfully before this task opened. PR #235 at c708426c983c0ca5f3ae38da588a9e368adb1337 and #236 at a54a1e0fddcb4b09e25c1ef98bff8505b0f13ed8 each change only the version of one Pages action. Independent reviews by Erdos and Hubble confirmed upload-pages-artifact v5 excludes dotfiles by default, including the generator's .nojekyll; deploy-pages v5 does not introduce that artifact change. The operator ruled manual Pages deployment main-only. Existing PRs remain open until the replacement has passed hosted validation and their exact heads are preserved for cleanup.
invariants: The workflow retains the existing main push and manual triggers; its deploy job runs only when github.ref is refs/heads/main, including manual dispatch.
Upload and deploy move together to v5; upload opts into hidden files only after a pre-upload guard rejects any dot-prefixed path other than an empty root .nojekyll, and rejects symlinks.
A clean generated site contains index.html and the empty .nojekyll; the guard fails closed on missing required files and unsafe paths without printing file contents.
No Pages deployment or release is triggered from dev by this batch. Windows development and Linux publishing commands remain valid.
A distinct author freezes the acceptance oracle before implementation. Full unchanged-tree gate, reasoned census growth and committed-tree mutation sweep precede closure.
rollback: Revert the workflow action and guard changes as one unit. The prior v3 uploader includes .nojekyll by default; no release has yet deployed the new workflow. Leave historical oracle and task evidence intact.
oracle_provenance: Pending independent ORACLE author before implementation.
